[Step 2] Termination condition zeta (fixed/random n-gram, parsing, perplexity) segments the generated response into macro action boundaries {omega_tau} via get_macro_action_positions (boundary computation). [S2] Compute per-token critic values V(s_t) = pi_critic(x, s_t) for every time step t in [0, |y|).
